3	> Common guidelines: executor-base.md. Technical constraints: shared-standards.md.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Role Definition
8	
9	A data-driven, consulting-style SVG design executor. Suitable for business analysis reports, market research, operational reviews, strategic recommendations, and other **general consulting** scenarios. Emphasizes structured information presentation and data visualization; clean, clear, and professional style.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Consultant-specific Data Visualization Techniques
14	
15	### 1. KPI Dashboard Design
16	
17	KPI cards are the most common element in consulting reports. Standard layout (1280x720):
18	
19	```
20	4-card layout: each card 280x180, gap 30
21	  Card 1: x=45,  y=160
22	  Card 2: x=355, y=160
23	  Card 3: x=665, y=160
24	  Card 4: x=975, y=160
25	```
26	
27	**Card internal structure** (top to bottom):
28	
29	| Area | Content | Font Size | Style |
30	|------|---------|-----------|-------|
31	| Icon row | data-icon icon | 32x32 | Theme color |
32	| Metric name | "Monthly Active Users" | 14px | Gray #64748B |
33	| Core number | "1.2M" | 36-42px | Bold, dark color |
34	| Trend annotation | "+12.3% vs last month" | 12px | Green=up / Red=down |
35	
36	**Trend arrow conventions**:
37	- Up: `arrow-trend-up` icon + green text
38	- Down: `arrow-trend-down` icon + red text
39	- Flat: horizontal line icon + gray text
40	
41	### 2. Chart Color Conventions
42	
43	Consulting-style charts use **monochromatic depth gradients** rather than rainbow colors:
44	
45	```
46	Primary series:   Theme color 100% opacity
47	Comparison series: Theme color 60% opacity
48	Baseline:         #94A3B8 (gray dashed line)
49	Highlight:        Accent color (only for key data points)
50	```
51	
52	### 3. Data Annotation Principles
53	
54	- **Direct data labels**: Place values at the top of bar charts — no legend needed
55	- **Annotated trend lines**: Add text notes at key inflection points ("Policy change", "Product launch")
56	- **Comparison baselines**: Mark industry average / target values with gray dashed lines
57	- **Consistent units**: Maintain the same numeric units and precision within a chart
58	
59	### 4. Table Design
60	
61	Consulting reports frequently use tables for precise data:
62	
63	| Design Element | Specification |
64	|----------------|---------------|
65	| Header | Dark background + white text, font-weight="bold" |
66	| Zebra striping | Alternate rows with `fill-opacity="0.05"` light background |
67	| Number alignment | Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned |
68	| Highlighted row | Mark key rows with accent color `fill-opacity="0.1"` |
69	| Borders | Use horizontal lines only to separate rows; avoid full grid lines |
70	
71	---
72	
73	## Consulting-specific Layout Patterns
74	
75	### MECE Decomposition Tree
76	
77	Main trunk on the left, branches expanding rightward — mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive:
78	
79	```
80	Main metric ──┬── Branch A (45%)
81	              ├── Branch B (30%)
82	              ├── Branch C (20%)
83	              └── Branch D (5%)
84	```
85	
86	- Use `<line>` to connect trunk to branches
87	- Each branch has a `<rect>` container + percentage annotation
88	- Sum must = 100% (or explicitly label "Other")
89	
90	### Driver Factor Tree
91	
92	Top-level metric → decomposed factors → actions. Ideal for performance attribution analysis:
93	
94	```
95	Revenue growth 15%
96	  ├── Average order value +8%  → Premium product line expansion
97	  ├── Customer count +5%       → New channel acquisition
98	  └── Repurchase rate +2%      → Loyalty program optimization
99	```
100	
101	### Left-chart Right-text (Chart Interpretation)
102	
103	Core consulting report layout: chart on the left, key insights on the right:
104	
105	```
106	Chart area: x=40, y=120, w=700, h=480
107	Insight area: x=780, y=120, w=460, h=480
108	  - Core conclusion (bold, 16px)
109	  - 3-5 bullet points (14px)
110	  - Data source (12px, gray)
111	```
112	
113	---
114	
115	## Professional Expression Standards
116	
117	### Page Titles
118	
119	Consulting-style page titles should be **assertion headlines**, not descriptive titles:
120	
121	| Type | Descriptive (avoid) | Assertion (recommended) |
122	|------|---------------------|------------------------|
123	| Market | "Market Overview" | "Domestic market grows 23% YoY, significantly outpacing global average" |
124	| Competition | "Competitive Analysis" | "Three major competitors show clear weaknesses in channel coverage" |
125	| Finance | "Financial Data" | "Gross margin improved for four consecutive quarters, breaking industry ceiling" |
126	
127	### Data Source Attribution
128	
129	Every data-containing page must include a source note at the bottom:
130	
131	```xml
132	<text x="40" y="700" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8">
133	  Source: National Bureau of Statistics 2025 Annual Report; Internal team analysis
134	</text>
135	```
136	
137	### Key Takeaway Box
138	
139	Consulting-style content pages should include a **Takeaway Box** below the title:
140	
141	```
142	Position: x=40, y=80, w=1200, h=50
143	Background: Light theme color (fill-opacity="0.08")
144	Text: 14-16px, one-sentence summary of the page's core takeaway
145	```
146	
147	---
148	
149	## Speaker Notes Style
150	
151	### Narrative Tone
152	
153	Consultant-style speaker notes use a **conclusion-driven** approach — state the conclusion first, then present supporting evidence. Professional, concise, and persuasive tone.
154	
155	### Stage Direction Markers
156	
157	| Marker | Purpose | Example |
158	|--------|---------|---------|
159	| `[Pause]` | Silence after key conclusions, let the audience absorb | "This means our market share is being eroded. [Pause]" |
160	| `[Data]` | Cue to verbalize numbers conversationally | "[Data] 85% → more than eight out of ten customers reported this issue" |
161	| `[Transition]` | Bridge from previous page, must be at start of each page's text | "[Transition] Based on that analysis, let's look at specific recommendations." |
162	
163	### Notes Writing Guidelines
164	
165	- **Conclusion first**: The first sentence of each page's notes is the core takeaway
166	- **Conversational data**: 30% → "roughly one-third", 85% → "more than eight out of ten", 2.5x → "two and a half times"
167	- **Evidence follows immediately**: After the conclusion, provide 2-3 supporting data points/facts
168	- **Professional terminology**: Use terms like "insight", "driver", "key lever" etc.
169	- **Key points structure**: `Key points: (1) Core conclusion (2) Supporting data (3) Next steps`
170	
171	### Notes Example
172	
173	```markdown
174	# 03_key_findings
175	
176	[Transition] Based on our market scan, we have distilled three key findings.
177	
178	First, the primary growth driver is shifting from acquisition to retention.
179	[Data] New customer acquisition cost rose nearly 40% year-over-year, yet improved repurchase rates contributed over 60% of revenue growth. [Pause]
180	
181	Second, lower-tier market growth significantly outpaces tier-1 and tier-2 cities.
182	Third, the 25-35 female user segment has an ARPU 1.8x the overall average.
183	
184	Key points: (1) Growth engine shifting from acquisition to retention (2) Lower-tier market opportunity window (3) High-value user persona
185	Duration: 2 minutes
186	```
187	
188	---
189	
190	## Self-check Supplement (Consultant-specific)
191	
192	- [ ] Data matches source data — no fabrication
193	- [ ] Every data page has a source attribution at the bottom
194	- [ ] Page titles are assertion-based, not descriptive
195	- [ ] KPI cards have trend arrows and comparison annotations
196	- [ ] Chart colors are unified, using monochromatic scheme rather than rainbow
197	- [ ] Notes are conclusion-first with conversational data
198

1	# Shared Technical Standards
2	
3	Common technical constraints for PPT Master, eliminating cross-role file duplication.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## 1. SVG Banned Features Blacklist
8	
9	The following features are **absolutely forbidden** when generating SVGs — PPT export will break if any are used:
10	
11	| Banned Feature | Description |
12	|----------------|-------------|
13	| `clipPath` | Clipping paths |
14	| `mask` | Masks |
15	| `<style>` | Embedded stylesheets |
16	| `class` | CSS selector attributes (`id` inside `<defs>` is a legitimate reference and is NOT banned) |
17	| External CSS | External stylesheet links |
18	| `<foreignObject>` | Embedded external content |
19	| `<symbol>` + `<use>` | Symbol reference reuse |
20	| `textPath` | Text along a path |
21	| `@font-face` | Custom font declarations |
22	| `<animate*>` / `<set>` | SVG animations |
23	| `<script>` / event attributes | Scripts and interactivity |
24	| `marker` / `marker-end` | Line endpoint markers |
25	| `<iframe>` | Embedded frames |
26	
27	---
28	
29	## 2. PPT Compatibility Alternatives
30	
31	| Banned Syntax | Correct Alternative |
32	|---------------|---------------------|
33	| `fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"` | `fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"` |
34	| `<g opacity="0.2">...</g>` | Set `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` on each child element individually |
35	| `<image opacity="0.3"/>` | Overlay a `<rect fill="background-color" opacity="0.7"/>` mask layer after the image |
36	| `marker-end` arrows | Draw triangle arrows with `<polygon>` |
37	
38	**Mnemonic**: PPT does not recognize rgba, group opacity, image opacity, or markers.
39	
40	---
41	
42	## 3. Canvas Format Quick Reference
43	
44	### Presentations
45	
46	| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
47	|--------|---------|------------|-------|
48	| PPT 16:9 | `0 0 1280 720` | 1280x720 | 16:9 |
49	| PPT 4:3 | `0 0 1024 768` | 1024x768 | 4:3 |
50	
51	### Social Media
52	
53	| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
54	|--------|---------|------------|-------|
55	| Xiaohongshu (RED) | `0 0 1242 1660` | 1242x1660 | 3:4 |
56	| WeChat Moments / Instagram Post | `0 0 1080 1080` | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
57	| Story / TikTok Vertical | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
58	
59	### Marketing Materials
60	
61	| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
62	|--------|---------|------------|-------|
63	| WeChat Article Header | `0 0 900 383` | 900x383 | 2.35:1 |
64	| Landscape Banner | `0 0 1920 1080` | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
65	| Portrait Poster | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
66	| A4 Print (150dpi) | `0 0 1240 1754` | 1240x1754 | 1:1.414 |
67	
68	---
69	
70	## 4. Basic SVG Rules
71	
72	- **viewBox** must match the canvas dimensions (`width`/`height` must match `viewBox`)
73	- **Background**: Use `<rect>` to define the page background color
74	- **Line breaks**: Use `<tspan>` for manual line breaks; `<foreignObject>` is FORBIDDEN
75	- **Fonts**: Use system fonts only (Microsoft YaHei, Arial, Calibri, etc.); `@font-face` is FORBIDDEN
76	- **Styles**: Use inline styles only (`fill="..."` `font-size="..."`); `<style>` / `class` are FORBIDDEN (`id` inside `<defs>` is legitimate)
77	- **Colors**: Use HEX values; for transparency use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
78	- **Image references**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
79	- **Icon placeholders**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" x="" y="" width="48" height="48" fill="#HEX"/>` (auto-embedded during post-processing)
80	
81	---
82	
83	## 5. Post-processing Pipeline (3 Steps)
84	
85	Must be executed in order — skipping or adding extra flags is FORBIDDEN:
86	
87	```bash
88	# 1. Split speaker notes into per-page note files
89	python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>
90	
91	# 2. SVG post-processing (icon embedding, image crop/embed, text flattening, rounded rect to path)
92	python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
93	
94	# 3. Export PPTX (from svg_final/, embeds speaker notes by default)
95	python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
96	# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
97	```
98	
99	**Prohibited**:
100	- NEVER use `cp` as a substitute for `finalize_svg.py`
101	- NEVER export directly from `svg_output/` — MUST export from `svg_final/` (use `-s final`)
102	- NEVER add extra flags like `--only`
103	
104	**Re-run rule**: Any modification to `svg_output/` after post-processing has completed (including page revisions, additions, or deletions) requires re-running Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 only needs re-running if `notes/total.md` was also modified.
105	
106	---
107	
108	## 6. Shadow & Overlay Techniques
109	
110	> `<mask>` elements and `<image opacity="...">` are banned. Always use stacked `<rect>` or gradient overlays instead (see §2).
111	
112	### Shadow
113	
114	#### Filter Soft Shadow — Recommended
115	
116	Best for: cards, floating panels, elevated elements. `svg_to_shapes.py` automatically converts `feGaussianBlur` + `feOffset` into native PPTX `<a:outerShdw>`.
117	
118	```xml
119	<defs>
120	  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
121	    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8"/>
122	    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
123	    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
124	    <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
125	    <feMerge>
126	      <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
127	      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
128	    </feMerge>
129	  </filter>
130	</defs>
131	<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
132	```
133	
134	Recommended parameters:
135	```
136	stdDeviation:   6–10     (smaller = crisper, larger = softer)
137	flood-opacity:  0.06–0.12  (keep low for a premium feel)
138	dy:             3–6      (vertical > horizontal for natural top-light)
139	dx:             0–2
140	```
141	
142	#### Colored Shadow
143	
144	Best for: accent buttons, brand-colored cards. Use the element's own color family instead of black.
145	
146	```xml
147	<filter id="colorShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
148	  <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
149	  <feOffset dx="0" dy="6" result="offsetBlur"/>
150	  <feFlood flood-color="#1A73E8" flood-opacity="0.20" result="shadowColor"/>
151	  <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
152	  <feMerge>
153	    <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
154	    <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
155	  </feMerge>
156	</filter>
157	```
158	
159	Replace `flood-color` with the element's brand color; keep `flood-opacity` between 0.12–0.20.
160	
161	#### Layered Rect Shadow — High-Compatibility Fallback
162	
163	Best for: maximum compatibility with older PowerPoint versions. Stack 2–3 semi-transparent rectangles behind the main card:
164	
165	```xml
166	<!-- Shadow layers (back to front, largest offset first) -->
167	<rect x="68" y="72" width="400" height="240" rx="16" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
168	<rect x="65" y="69" width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
169	<rect x="62" y="66" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#1A73E8" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
170	<!-- Main card -->
171	<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
172	```
173	
174	### Image Overlay
175	
176	#### Linear Gradient Overlay — Most Common
177	
178	Best for: image+text pages. Gradient direction should match text position (text on left → gradient darkens toward left).
179	
180	```xml
181	<image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
182	<defs>
183	  <linearGradient id="imgOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
184	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
185	    <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
186	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0"/>
187	  </linearGradient>
188	</defs>
189	<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#imgOverlay)"/>
190	```
191	
192	#### Bottom Gradient Bar
193	
194	Best for: cover slides and full-image pages with bottom title.
195	
196	```xml
197	<defs>
198	  <linearGradient id="bottomBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
199	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
200	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
201	  </linearGradient>
202	</defs>
203	<rect x="0" y="380" width="1280" height="340" fill="url(#bottomBar)"/>
204	```
205	
206	#### Radial Gradient Overlay — Vignette Effect
207	
208	Best for: full-screen atmosphere slides; draws attention to the center.
209	
210	```xml
211	<defs>
212	  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
213	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
214	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.58"/>
215	  </radialGradient>
216	</defs>
217	<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
218	```
219	
220	#### Brand Color Overlay
221	
222	Best for: slides needing strong visual brand identity.
223	
224	```xml
225	<defs>
226	  <linearGradient id="brandOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
227	    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.80"/>
228	    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
229	  </linearGradient>
230	</defs>
231	<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#brandOverlay)"/>
232	```
233	
234	### Quick-Reference Table
235	
236	| Scenario | Recommended Technique | Avoid |
237	|----------|-----------------------|-------|
238	| Card / panel shadow | Filter soft shadow (`flood-opacity` ≤ 0.12) | Hard black shadow |
239	| Accent / CTA button | Colored shadow (same hue family) | Generic gray shadow |
240	| Text over image | Linear gradient overlay (direction matches text side) | Uniform flat opacity over whole image |
241	| Cover / full-image slide | Bottom gradient bar + brand color | Solid black overlay |
242	| Atmosphere / hero slide | Radial vignette | Unprocessed raw image |
243	| Max PPT compatibility needed | Layered rect shadow | Filter-based shadow |
244	
245	---
246	
247	## 7. Project Directory Structure
248	
249	```
250	project/
251	├── svg_output/    # Raw SVGs (Executor output, contains placeholders)
252	├── svg_final/     # Post-processed final SVGs (finalize_svg.py output)
253	├── images/        # Image assets (user-provided + AI-generated)
254	├── notes/         # Speaker notes (.md files matching SVG names)
255	│   └── total.md   # Complete speaker notes document (before splitting)
256	├── templates/     # Project templates (if any)
257	└── *.pptx         # Exported PPT file
258	```
259

But you MUST refuse to improve or augment the code. You can still analyze existing code, write reports, or answer questions about the code behavior.

# Shared Technical Standards

Common technical constraints for PPT Master, eliminating cross-role file duplication.

---

## 1. SVG Banned Features Blacklist

The following features are **absolutely forbidden** when generating SVGs — PPT export will break if any are used:

| Banned Feature | Description |
|----------------|-------------|
| `clipPath` | Clipping paths |
| `mask` | Masks |
| `<style>` | Embedded stylesheets |
| `class` | CSS selector attributes (`id` inside `<defs>` is a legitimate reference and is NOT banned) |
| External CSS | External stylesheet links |
| `<foreignObject>` | Embedded external content |
| `<symbol>` + `<use>` | Symbol reference reuse |
| `textPath` | Text along a path |
| `@font-face` | Custom font declarations |
| `<animate*>` / `<set>` | SVG animations |
| `<script>` / event attributes | Scripts and interactivity |
| `marker` / `marker-end` | Line endpoint markers |
| `<iframe>` | Embedded frames |

---

## 2. PPT Compatibility Alternatives

| Banned Syntax | Correct Alternative |
|---------------|---------------------|
| `fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"` | `fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| `<g opacity="0.2">...</g>` | Set `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` on each child element individually |
| `<image opacity="0.3"/>` | Overlay a `<rect fill="background-color" opacity="0.7"/>` mask layer after the image |
| `marker-end` arrows | Draw triangle arrows with `<polygon>` |

**Mnemonic**: PPT does not recognize rgba, group opacity, image opacity, or markers.

---

## 3. Canvas Format Quick Reference

### Presentations

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| PPT 16:9 | `0 0 1280 720` | 1280x720 | 16:9 |
| PPT 4:3 | `0 0 1024 768` | 1024x768 | 4:3 |

### Social Media

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Xiaohongshu (RED) | `0 0 1242 1660` | 1242x1660 | 3:4 |
| WeChat Moments / Instagram Post | `0 0 1080 1080` | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
| Story / TikTok Vertical | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |

### Marketing Materials

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| WeChat Article Header | `0 0 900 383` | 900x383 | 2.35:1 |
| Landscape Banner | `0 0 1920 1080` | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
| Portrait Poster | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
| A4 Print (150dpi) | `0 0 1240 1754` | 1240x1754 | 1:1.414 |

---

## 4. Basic SVG Rules

- **viewBox** must match the canvas dimensions (`width`/`height` must match `viewBox`)
- **Background**: Use `<rect>` to define the page background color
- **Line breaks**: Use `<tspan>` for manual line breaks; `<foreignObject>` is FORBIDDEN
- **Fonts**: Use system fonts only (Microsoft YaHei, Arial, Calibri, etc.); `@font-face` is FORBIDDEN
- **Styles**: Use inline styles only (`fill="..."` `font-size="..."`); `<style>` / `class` are FORBIDDEN (`id` inside `<defs>` is legitimate)
- **Colors**: Use HEX values; for transparency use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
- **Image references**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
- **Icon placeholders**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" x="" y="" width="48" height="48" fill="#HEX"/>` (auto-embedded during post-processing)

---

## 5. Post-processing Pipeline (3 Steps)

Must be executed in order — skipping or adding extra flags is FORBIDDEN:

```bash
# 1. Split speaker notes into per-page note files
python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>

# 2. SVG post-processing (icon embedding, image crop/embed, text flattening, rounded rect to path)
python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>

# 3. Export PPTX (from svg_final/, embeds speaker notes by default)
python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
```

**Prohibited**:
- NEVER use `cp` as a substitute for `finalize_svg.py`
- NEVER export directly from `svg_output/` — MUST export from `svg_final/` (use `-s final`)
- NEVER add extra flags like `--only`

**Re-run rule**: Any modification to `svg_output/` after post-processing has completed (including page revisions, additions, or deletions) requires re-running Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 only needs re-running if `notes/total.md` was also modified.

---

## 6. Shadow & Overlay Techniques

> `<mask>` elements and `<image opacity="...">` are banned. Always use stacked `<rect>` or gradient overlays instead (see §2).

### Shadow

#### Filter Soft Shadow — Recommended

Best for: cards, floating panels, elevated elements. `svg_to_shapes.py` automatically converts `feGaussianBlur` + `feOffset` into native PPTX `<a:outerShdw>`.

```xml
<defs>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8"/>
    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
    <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
    <feMerge>
      <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
    </feMerge>
  </filter>
</defs>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
```

Recommended parameters:
```
stdDeviation:   6–10     (smaller = crisper, larger = softer)
flood-opacity:  0.06–0.12  (keep low for a premium feel)
dy:             3–6      (vertical > horizontal for natural top-light)
dx:             0–2
```

#### Colored Shadow

Best for: accent buttons, brand-colored cards. Use the element's own color family instead of black.

```xml
<filter id="colorShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
  <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
  <feOffset dx="0" dy="6" result="offsetBlur"/>
  <feFlood flood-color="#1A73E8" flood-opacity="0.20" result="shadowColor"/>
  <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
  <feMerge>
    <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
    <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
  </feMerge>
</filter>
```

Replace `flood-color` with the element's brand color; keep `flood-opacity` between 0.12–0.20.

#### Layered Rect Shadow — High-Compatibility Fallback

Best for: maximum compatibility with older PowerPoint versions. Stack 2–3 semi-transparent rectangles behind the main card:

```xml
<!-- Shadow layers (back to front, largest offset first) -->
<rect x="68" y="72" width="400" height="240" rx="16" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
<rect x="65" y="69" width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
<rect x="62" y="66" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#1A73E8" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
<!-- Main card -->
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
```

### Image Overlay

#### Linear Gradient Overlay — Most Common

Best for: image+text pages. Gradient direction should match text position (text on left → gradient darkens toward left).

```xml
<image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="imgOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#imgOverlay)"/>
```

#### Bottom Gradient Bar

Best for: cover slides and full-image pages with bottom title.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="bottomBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="380" width="1280" height="340" fill="url(#bottomBar)"/>
```

#### Radial Gradient Overlay — Vignette Effect

Best for: full-screen atmosphere slides; draws attention to the center.

```xml
<defs>
  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.58"/>
  </radialGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
```

#### Brand Color Overlay

Best for: slides needing strong visual brand identity.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="brandOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.80"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#brandOverlay)"/>
```

### Quick-Reference Table

| Scenario | Recommended Technique | Avoid |
|----------|-----------------------|-------|
| Card / panel shadow | Filter soft shadow (`flood-opacity` ≤ 0.12) | Hard black shadow |
| Accent / CTA button | Colored shadow (same hue family) | Generic gray shadow |
| Text over image | Linear gradient overlay (direction matches text side) | Uniform flat opacity over whole image |
| Cover / full-image slide | Bottom gradient bar + brand color | Solid black overlay |
| Atmosphere / hero slide | Radial vignette | Unprocessed raw image |
| Max PPT compatibility needed | Layered rect shadow | Filter-based shadow |

---

## 7. Project Directory Structure

```
project/
├── svg_output/    # Raw SVGs (Executor output, contains placeholders)
├── svg_final/     # Post-processed final SVGs (finalize_svg.py output)
├── images/        # Image assets (user-provided + AI-generated)
├── notes/         # Speaker notes (.md files matching SVG names)
│   └── total.md   # Complete speaker notes document (before splitting)
├── templates/     # Project templates (if any)
└── *.pptx         # Exported PPT file
```

# Shared Technical Standards

Common technical constraints for PPT Master, eliminating cross-role file duplication.

---

## 1. SVG Banned Features Blacklist

The following features are **absolutely forbidden** when generating SVGs — PPT export will break if any are used:

| Banned Feature | Description |
|----------------|-------------|
| `clipPath` | Clipping paths |
| `mask` | Masks |
| `<style>` | Embedded stylesheets |
| `class` | CSS selector attributes (`id` inside `<defs>` is a legitimate reference and is NOT banned) |
| External CSS | External stylesheet links |
| `<foreignObject>` | Embedded external content |
| `<symbol>` + `<use>` | Symbol reference reuse |
| `textPath` | Text along a path |
| `@font-face` | Custom font declarations |
| `<animate*>` / `<set>` | SVG animations |
| `<script>` / event attributes | Scripts and interactivity |
| `marker` / `marker-end` | Line endpoint markers |
| `<iframe>` | Embedded frames |

---

## 2. PPT Compatibility Alternatives

| Banned Syntax | Correct Alternative |
|---------------|---------------------|
| `fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.1)"` | `fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"` |
| `<g opacity="0.2">...</g>` | Set `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity` on each child element individually |
| `<image opacity="0.3"/>` | Overlay a `<rect fill="background-color" opacity="0.7"/>` mask layer after the image |
| `marker-end` arrows | Draw triangle arrows with `<polygon>` |

**Mnemonic**: PPT does not recognize rgba, group opacity, image opacity, or markers.

---

## 3. Canvas Format Quick Reference

### Presentations

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| PPT 16:9 | `0 0 1280 720` | 1280x720 | 16:9 |
| PPT 4:3 | `0 0 1024 768` | 1024x768 | 4:3 |

### Social Media

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| Xiaohongshu (RED) | `0 0 1242 1660` | 1242x1660 | 3:4 |
| WeChat Moments / Instagram Post | `0 0 1080 1080` | 1080x1080 | 1:1 |
| Story / TikTok Vertical | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |

### Marketing Materials

| Format | viewBox | Dimensions | Ratio |
|--------|---------|------------|-------|
| WeChat Article Header | `0 0 900 383` | 900x383 | 2.35:1 |
| Landscape Banner | `0 0 1920 1080` | 1920x1080 | 16:9 |
| Portrait Poster | `0 0 1080 1920` | 1080x1920 | 9:16 |
| A4 Print (150dpi) | `0 0 1240 1754` | 1240x1754 | 1:1.414 |

---

## 4. Basic SVG Rules

- **viewBox** must match the canvas dimensions (`width`/`height` must match `viewBox`)
- **Background**: Use `<rect>` to define the page background color
- **Line breaks**: Use `<tspan>` for manual line breaks; `<foreignObject>` is FORBIDDEN
- **Fonts**: Use system fonts only (Microsoft YaHei, Arial, Calibri, etc.); `@font-face` is FORBIDDEN
- **Styles**: Use inline styles only (`fill="..."` `font-size="..."`); `<style>` / `class` are FORBIDDEN (`id` inside `<defs>` is legitimate)
- **Colors**: Use HEX values; for transparency use `fill-opacity` / `stroke-opacity`
- **Image references**: `<image href="../images/xxx.png" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>`
- **Icon placeholders**: `<use data-icon="icon-name" x="" y="" width="48" height="48" fill="#HEX"/>` (auto-embedded during post-processing)

---

## 5. Post-processing Pipeline (3 Steps)

Must be executed in order — skipping or adding extra flags is FORBIDDEN:

```bash
# 1. Split speaker notes into per-page note files
python3 scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>

# 2. SVG post-processing (icon embedding, image crop/embed, text flattening, rounded rect to path)
python3 scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>

# 3. Export PPTX (from svg_final/, embeds speaker notes by default)
python3 scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path> -s final
# Default: generates native shapes (.pptx) + SVG reference (_svg.pptx)
```

**Prohibited**:
- NEVER use `cp` as a substitute for `finalize_svg.py`
- NEVER export directly from `svg_output/` — MUST export from `svg_final/` (use `-s final`)
- NEVER add extra flags like `--only`

**Re-run rule**: Any modification to `svg_output/` after post-processing has completed (including page revisions, additions, or deletions) requires re-running Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 only needs re-running if `notes/total.md` was also modified.

---

## 6. Shadow & Overlay Techniques

> `<mask>` elements and `<image opacity="...">` are banned. Always use stacked `<rect>` or gradient overlays instead (see §2).

### Shadow

#### Filter Soft Shadow — Recommended

Best for: cards, floating panels, elevated elements. `svg_to_shapes.py` automatically converts `feGaussianBlur` + `feOffset` into native PPTX `<a:outerShdw>`.

```xml
<defs>
  <filter id="softShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="8"/>
    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetBlur"/>
    <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08" result="shadowColor"/>
    <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
    <feMerge>
      <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
      <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
    </feMerge>
  </filter>
</defs>
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
```

Recommended parameters:
```
stdDeviation:   6–10     (smaller = crisper, larger = softer)
flood-opacity:  0.06–0.12  (keep low for a premium feel)
dy:             3–6      (vertical > horizontal for natural top-light)
dx:             0–2
```

#### Colored Shadow

Best for: accent buttons, brand-colored cards. Use the element's own color family instead of black.

```xml
<filter id="colorShadow" x="-15%" y="-15%" width="140%" height="140%">
  <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
  <feOffset dx="0" dy="6" result="offsetBlur"/>
  <feFlood flood-color="#1A73E8" flood-opacity="0.20" result="shadowColor"/>
  <feComposite in="shadowColor" in2="offsetBlur" operator="in" result="shadow"/>
  <feMerge>
    <feMergeNode in="shadow"/>
    <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
  </feMerge>
</filter>
```

Replace `flood-color` with the element's brand color; keep `flood-opacity` between 0.12–0.20.

#### Layered Rect Shadow — High-Compatibility Fallback

Best for: maximum compatibility with older PowerPoint versions. Stack 2–3 semi-transparent rectangles behind the main card:

```xml
<!-- Shadow layers (back to front, largest offset first) -->
<rect x="68" y="72" width="400" height="240" rx="16" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.03"/>
<rect x="65" y="69" width="400" height="240" rx="14" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.05"/>
<rect x="62" y="66" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#1A73E8" fill-opacity="0.04"/>
<!-- Main card -->
<rect x="60" y="60" width="400" height="240" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
```

### Image Overlay

#### Linear Gradient Overlay — Most Common

Best for: image+text pages. Gradient direction should match text position (text on left → gradient darkens toward left).

```xml
<image href="..." x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"/>
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="imgOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    <stop offset="55%"  stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1A1A2E" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#imgOverlay)"/>
```

#### Bottom Gradient Bar

Best for: cover slides and full-image pages with bottom title.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="bottomBar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.72"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="380" width="1280" height="340" fill="url(#bottomBar)"/>
```

#### Radial Gradient Overlay — Vignette Effect

Best for: full-screen atmosphere slides; draws attention to the center.

```xml
<defs>
  <radialGradient id="vignette" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="70%">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.58"/>
  </radialGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#vignette)"/>
```

#### Brand Color Overlay

Best for: slides needing strong visual brand identity.

```xml
<defs>
  <linearGradient id="brandOverlay" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
    <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.80"/>
    <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#005587" stop-opacity="0.10"/>
  </linearGradient>
</defs>
<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#brandOverlay)"/>
```

### Quick-Reference Table

| Scenario | Recommended Technique | Avoid |
|----------|-----------------------|-------|
| Card / panel shadow | Filter soft shadow (`flood-opacity` ≤ 0.12) | Hard black shadow |
| Accent / CTA button | Colored shadow (same hue family) | Generic gray shadow |
| Text over image | Linear gradient overlay (direction matches text side) | Uniform flat opacity over whole image |
| Cover / full-image slide | Bottom gradient bar + brand color | Solid black overlay |
| Atmosphere / hero slide | Radial vignette | Unprocessed raw image |
| Max PPT compatibility needed | Layered rect shadow | Filter-based shadow |

---

## 7. Project Directory Structure

```
project/
├── svg_output/    # Raw SVGs (Executor output, contains placeholders)
├── svg_final/     # Post-processed final SVGs (finalize_svg.py output)
├── images/        # Image assets (user-provided + AI-generated)
├── notes/         # Speaker notes (.md files matching SVG names)
│   └── total.md   # Complete speaker notes document (before splitting)
├── templates/     # Project templates (if any)
└── *.pptx         # Exported PPT file
```

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    水平条形图模板
    用途: 类别排名、数值对比（适合类别名称较长的场景）
    适用场景: 销售排行榜、品牌认知度、满意度评分
    支持: 8个条形（可调整为5-12个）
    与柱状图区别: 水平展示，更适合排名和类别名较长的数据
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 条形渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad1" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2196F3;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad2" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4CAF50;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <linearGradient id="hbarGrad3" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF9800;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#FFB74D;stop-opacity:1" />
        </linearGradient>
        
        <!-- 阴影 -->
        <filter id="hbarShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="1" dy="0"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.2"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>品牌认知度排行榜</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年消费者调研报告 · 样本量 N=5,000</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- X轴网格线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="660" y1="140" x2="660" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="840" y1="140" x2="840" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1020" y1="140" x2="1020" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="1200" y1="140" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        
        <!-- X轴刻度标签 -->
        <text x="300" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>0%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="480" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>20%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="660" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>40%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="840" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>60%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1020" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>80%</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="1200" y="650" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>100%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- Y轴基线 -->
        <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="300" y1="620" x2="1200" y2="620" stroke="#95A5A6" stroke-width="2"/>
        
        <!-- 条形数据 (条高36px, 间距24px, 总间距60px) -->
        
        <!-- 条形1: 品牌A - 92% (第1名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="175" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌A (市场领导者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="155" width="828" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1138" y="179" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>92%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形2: 品牌B - 78% (第2名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="235" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌B (新锐品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="215" width="702" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="1012" y="239" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>78%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形3: 品牌C - 65% (第3名，蓝色) -->
        <text x="290" y="295" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌C (经典品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="275" width="585" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="895" y="299" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>65%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形4: 品牌D - 52% (第4名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="355" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌D (区域品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="335" width="468" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="778" y="359" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>52%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形5: 品牌E - 45% (第5名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="415" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌E (性价比品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="395" width="405" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="715" y="419" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>45%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形6: 品牌F - 38% (第6名，绿色) -->
        <text x="290" y="475" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌F (高端品牌)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="455" width="342" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="652" y="479" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>38%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形7: 品牌G - 25% (第7名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="535" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>品牌G (新进入者)</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="515" width="225" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="535" y="539" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>25%</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <!-- 条形8: 其他 - 12% (第8名，橙色) -->
        <text x="290" y="595" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="end">
            <tspan>其他品牌</tspan>
        </text>
        <rect x="300" y="575" width="108" height="36" rx="4" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)" filter="url(#hbarShadow)"/>
        <text x="418" y="599" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#2C3E50">
            <tspan>12%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend">
        <rect x="60" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad1)"/>
        <text x="85" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>高认知度 (≥50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="240" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad2)"/>
        <text x="265" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>中等认知度 (30-50%)</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <rect x="450" y="660" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="url(#hbarGrad3)"/>
        <text x="475" y="673" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="14" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>低认知度 (<30%)</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 数据来源 -->
    <text x="1220" y="695" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="14" fill="#95A5A6" text-anchor="end">
        <tspan>数据来源: 市场研究部门</tspan>
    </text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    环形图模板
    用途: 占比和构成分析
    适用场景: 市场份额、预算分配、结构分析
    支持: 5个分块 (推荐3-6个)
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 扇区阴影 -->
        <filter id="sectorShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="3"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="2"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.25"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="80" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>产品线营收占比</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="115" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年第三季度 · 总收入 5.2亿元</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 环形图中心 -->
    <g id="donutChart" transform="translate(400, 410)">
        <!-- 
        圆心: (400, 410)
        外半径: 180px
        内半径: 100px
        起始角度: -90° (12点方向)
        
        数据:
        1. 企业服务: 35% (蓝色 #2196F3) - 角度: 126°
        2. 消费电子: 28% (绿色 #4CAF50) - 角度: 100.8°
        3. 云计算: 20% (橙色 #FF9800) - 角度: 72°
        4. 物联网: 12% (紫色 #9C27B0) - 角度: 43.2°
        5. 其他: 5% (灰色 #95A5A6) - 角度: 18°
        -->
        
        <!-- 扇区1: 企业服务 35% (从-90°到36°) -->
        <path d="M 0,-180 A 180,180 0 0,1 156.36,88.18 L 86.87,49.04 A 100,100 0 0,0 0,-100 Z" 
              fill="#2196F3" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区2: 消费电子 28% (从36°到136.8°) -->
        <path d="M 156.36,88.18 A 180,180 0 0,1 -123.43,130.14 L -68.57,72.30 A 100,100 0 0,0 86.87,49.04 Z" 
              fill="#4CAF50" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区3: 云计算 20% (从136.8°到208.8°) -->
        <path d="M -123.43,130.14 A 180,180 0 0,1 -175.36,-51.76 L -97.42,-28.76 A 100,100 0 0,0 -68.57,72.30 Z" 
              fill="#FF9800" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区4: 物联网 12% (从208.8°到252°) -->
        <path d="M -175.36,-51.76 A 180,180 0 0,1 -54.46,-171.54 L -30.26,-95.30 A 100,100 0 0,0 -97.42,-28.76 Z" 
              fill="#9C27B0" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 扇区5: 其他 5% (从252°到270°/360°-90°) -->
        <path d="M -54.46,-171.54 A 180,180 0 0,1 0,-180 L 0,-100 A 100,100 0 0,0 -30.26,-95.30 Z" 
              fill="#95A5A6" filter="url(#sectorShadow)"/>
        
        <!-- 中心白色圆 -->
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="100" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
        
        <!-- 中心文字 -->
        <text x="0" y="-15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="48" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>5.2亿</tspan>
        </text>
        <text x="0" y="20" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D" text-anchor="middle">
            <tspan>总收入</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 百分比标签 -->
    <!-- 标签1: 企业服务 35% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="530" y1="295" x2="620" y2="250" stroke="#2196F3" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="530" cy="295" r="3" fill="#2196F3"/>
        <text x="630" y="255" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#2196F3">
            <tspan>35%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 标签2: 消费电子 28% -->
    <g>
        <line x1="510" y1="500" x2="620" y2="540" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="510" cy="500" r="3" fill="#4CAF50"/>
        <text x="630" y="545" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif" 
              font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#4CAF50">
            <tspan>28%</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 标签3: 云计算 20% -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="1280" height="720">
    <!-- 
    散点图模板
    用途: 相关性分析、数据分布展示
    适用场景: 价格vs销量、投入vs产出、身高vs体重
    支持: 2个系列，每系列多个数据点
    -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 数据点阴影 -->
        <filter id="scatterShadow">
            <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2"/>
            <feOffset dx="0" dy="1"/>
            <feComponentTransfer>
                <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
            </feComponentTransfer>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
        
        <!-- 系列1渐变 -->
        <radialGradient id="dotGrad1" cx="30%" cy="30%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#42A5F5;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1976D2;stop-opacity:1" />
        </radialGradient>
        
        <!-- 系列2渐变 -->
        <radialGradient id="dotGrad2" cx="30%" cy="30%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#66BB6A;stop-opacity:1" />
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#388E3C;stop-opacity:1" />
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- 标题 -->
    <text x="60" y="70" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="32" font-weight="bold" fill="#2C3E50">
        <tspan>广告投入与销售额关系分析</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <text x="60" y="105" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
          font-size="18" fill="#7F8C8D">
        <tspan>2025年各区域数据 · 样本量 N=24</tspan>
    </text>
    
    <!-- 图例 -->
    <g id="legend" transform="translate(950, 70)">
        <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="url(#dotGrad1)"/>
        <text x="28" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>线上渠道</tspan>
        </text>
        
        <circle cx="130" cy="10" r="8" fill="url(#dotGrad2)"/>
        <text x="148" y="15" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif" 
              font-size="15" fill="#5D6D7E">
            <tspan>线下渠道</tspan>
        </text>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 图表区域 -->
    <g id="chartArea">
        <!-- 网格线 -->
        <!-- 水平网格线 -->
        <line x1="140" y1="560" x2="1100" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="140" y1="470" x2="1100" y2="470" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>

        <line x1="780" y1="160" x2="780" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
        <line x1="940" y1="160" x2="940" y2="560" stroke="#E0E0E0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>

        Y: 560 - (value/800) * 400
        -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 封面页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->

        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">

            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.03" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>

    <!-- 神经网络连接线 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.4" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M100,200 Q250,150 350,220"/>

        <path d="M900,480 Q1000,420 1100,480"/>
        <path d="M1100,480 Q1150,550 1200,500"/>

    <!-- 蓝色节点 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="100" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="220" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="500" cy="200" r="4"/>
        <circle cx="900" cy="480" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="480" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="1200" cy="500" r="4"/>

    <!-- 橙色节点 -->

        <circle cx="1050" cy="180" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1150" cy="120" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="180" cy="520" r="6"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 左上角装饰短线 -->

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1280 720">
    <!-- 模板: 结束页 - Anthropic 风格 -->
    
    <defs>
        <!-- 背景渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#1A1A2E"/>
            <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#16213E"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#0F0F1A"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 橙色渐变 -->
        <linearGradient id="accentGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#E8956F"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <!-- 光晕效果 -->
        <radialGradient id="glowOrange" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0.2"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#D97757;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
        <radialGradient id="glowBlue" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
            <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0.15"/>
            <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A90D9;stop-opacity:0"/>
        </radialGradient>
    </defs>
    
    <!-- 渐变背景 -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#bgGradient)"/>
    
    <!-- 网格装饰线 -->
    <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.02" stroke-width="1">
        <line x1="0" y1="180" x2="1280" y2="180"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="360" x2="1280" y2="360"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540"/>
        <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="320" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="640" y1="0" x2="640" y2="720"/>
        <line x1="960" y1="0" x2="960" y2="720"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 光晕效果 -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="200" rx="250" ry="180" fill="url(#glowBlue)"/>
    <ellipse cx="980" cy="500" rx="280" ry="200" fill="url(#glowOrange)"/>
    
    <!-- 神经网络连接装饰 -->
    <g stroke="#4A90D9" stroke-opacity="0.3" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
        <path d="M150,150 Q250,100 350,180"/>
        <path d="M350,180 Q420,250 380,320"/>
        <path d="M950,400 Q1050,350 1100,420"/>
        <path d="M1100,420 Q1150,500 1080,550"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 节点装饰 -->
    <g fill="#4A90D9" fill-opacity="0.5">
        <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="5"/>
        <circle cx="350" cy="180" r="7"/>
        <circle cx="380" cy="320" r="4"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#D97757" fill-opacity="0.6">
        <circle cx="950" cy="400" r="6"/>
        <circle cx="1100" cy="420" r="8"/>
        <circle cx="1080" cy="550" r="5"/>
    </g>
    
    <!-- 感谢语标签 -->
    <text x="640" y="240" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#D97757" letter-spacing="3">
        THANK YOU
    </text>
    
    <!-- 主感谢语 -->
    <text x="640" y="310" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="52" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{THANK_YOU}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 装饰分隔线 -->
    <rect x="540" y="350" width="200" height="3" fill="url(#accentGradient)" rx="1.5"/>
    
    <!-- 副标语 -->
    <text x="640" y="410" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{TAGLINE}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 联系信息卡片 -->
    <rect x="440" y="460" width="400" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.05" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.1" stroke-width="1" rx="12"/>
    
    <text x="640" y="505" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">
        {{CONTACT_NAME}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.7">
        {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}
    </text>
    <text x="640" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.6">
        {{CONTACT_URL}}
    </text>
    
    <!-- 底部分隔线 -->
    <rect x="60" y="640" width="1160" height="1" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.1"/>
    
    <!-- 底部信息 -->
    <text x="60" y="680" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{DATE}}
    </text>
    <text x="1220" y="680" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748B">
        {{COPYRIGHT}}
    </text>

</svg>

arguments.content:
# 01_cover

[Transition] Welcome. Today we're going to look at something striking — a single snapshot of what GitHub's developer community is building, trending, and rallying around in real time.

This is a data story about 20 repositories. Specifically, the top 20 trending repos on GitHub over the last 24 hours, ranked by OSSInsight's composite scoring system across 10.6 billion tracked events. [Pause]

The headline is almost hard to believe: roughly 70% of trending GitHub activity right now — in a single day — clusters around one theme: AI coding agents and Claude Code tooling.

Key points: (1) Set the scene — this is a real-time snapshot, not a survey (2) OSSInsight is the authoritative data source (3) The dominant theme is AI coding agents
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 02_platform_overview

[Transition] Before we dive into the data, let's quickly establish why we should trust it.

OSSInsight tracks over 10.6 billion GitHub events — stars, forks, commits, pull requests, issues, and code reviews — in real time. Every trending ranking you're about to see is built on that foundation. [Data] 10.6 billion — that's not a sample. That's essentially the full GitHub event stream.

The scoring formula is transparent: Total Score equals Stars Score plus Forks Score plus Base Score. Stars signal attention, forks signal developer intent to build, and base score captures historical momentum. Together, they produce a composite ranking that's harder to game than raw star counts alone.

Key points: (1) OSSInsight credibility established — 10.6B events (2) Scoring formula is multi-metric — not just stars (3) This is the data foundation for everything that follows
Duration: 1.5 minutes

---

# 03_top5_repos

[Transition] Let's start at the top. Here are the five highest-scoring repositories from the past 24 hours.

[Data] Number one: NousResearch/hermes-agent, with 1,347 stars in a single day. That's nearly 1.8 times the #2 repository, graphify, which earned 742 stars. But the gap widens even more dramatically when you look at community activity: hermes-agent attracted 78 pull requests and 42 pushes in 24 hours. [Pause] Every other top-5 repo combined had fewer than 10 PRs.

Numbers 4 and 5 — claude-code-best-practice and caveman — are both explicitly Claude Code tools, and they're already in the top five by total score. This is a signal we'll explore in depth in a moment.

Key points: (1) hermes-agent has commanding multi-metric lead (2) Stars gap alone understates hermes-agent's dominance — PRs tell the real story (3) Two Claude Code tools already in top 5
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 04_language_distribution

[Transition] Now let's look at the language behind these repos — because it tells us a lot about where the AI tooling ecosystem is anchored.

Python dominates at 35% — seven of the top 20 repos. That's the AI and ML ecosystem's native language, and it reflects the inference, agent orchestration, and scripting layers of most AI coding tools. TypeScript follows at 20% — four repos — representing the frontend, developer experience, and agent UI frameworks that wrap these Python backends. [Pause]

Together, Python and TypeScript account for more than half of all trending repos. The rest of the distribution — HTML, Rust, Swift, Shell, Java, and one unspecified repo — fills in the remaining 45%, but no single language comes close to Python's lead.

Key points: (1) Python + TypeScript = 55% combined, reflecting AI backend + agent frontend stack (2) Rust appearing in 2 repos — token efficiency and multi-tool switching (3) Unspecified language: one repo has no language tag — early-stage signal
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 05_category_breakdown

[Transition] The language distribution points us toward the topic distribution — and this is where the story gets striking.

We've grouped the top 20 repos into four thematic buckets. AI Coding Agents and Skills — that's the largest bucket at 50%, ten repos. Claude Code Ecosystem Tools specifically — five repos, 25%. AI Infrastructure and Research — three repos, 15%. Developer Utilities — the remaining repos, roughly 10–15%. [Pause]

Add up those first two categories and you get 14 of 20 repos — 70% — directly related to AI coding assistance. This isn't a gradual trend. This is a category capture event happening in real time.

And there's an emerging sub-theme worth watching: token efficiency. Multiple repos are focused specifically on reducing LLM token consumption — caveman claims 75% reduction, rtk claims 60 to 90%. As AI coding tools move from individual developers to teams, cost becomes a constraint. This sub-theme will likely grow.

Key points: (1) 70% concentration in a single theme is historically unusual for GitHub trending (2) Claude Code alone accounts for 25% of all trending repos (3) Token efficiency sub-theme is an early signal of enterprise cost awareness
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 06_claude_code_ecosystem

[Transition] Let me now focus specifically on Claude Code, because what happened in the past 24 hours around Anthropic's coding tool is remarkable.

Five repos are explicitly Claude Code tools: a best-practices collection, a visual how-to guide, a multi-tool switcher for Claude Code and its competitors, a token-cutting skill called caveman, and a ground-up educational implementation. Add in two cross-listed repos from the broader AI agent category — agent-skills and oh-my-codex — and you have at least seven repos broadly serving Claude Code users, all appearing on GitHub trending within the same 24-hour window.

[Pause] That's not a coincidence. That's a community formation event. The sub-themes within this ecosystem — token efficiency, multi-tool switching, learning guides, skill extensions — suggest that developers are already building a mature support ecosystem around a tool that only recently launched.

Key points: (1) 7+ repos = ecosystem, not isolated projects (2) Three distinct sub-themes signal ecosystem maturity beginning (3) Strategic implication: Claude Code has community momentum that compound with time
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 07_community_engagement

[Transition] Stars tell you who got attention. Pull requests and pushes tell you who is actually building.

On this scatter plot, the X axis is pushes in 24 hours, the Y axis is pull requests. Dot size represents star count. And the pattern is stark. [Data] hermes-agent sits alone in the upper right — 78 PRs, 42 pushes — while every other repo clusters in the lower left. Eight repos have exactly zero PRs in this time window. [Pause]

This is the difference between virality and community. Many repos here earned significant stars — 300, 600, even 742 — because they appeared on trending and people starred them. But stars don't require anyone to read the code, let alone contribute. Only a handful of repos have the collaborative activity that characterizes a real open-source community in motion.

multica is the notable second — 35 pushes and 7 PRs — which makes sense given its premise: coding agents acting as real teammates. If your repo automates collaboration, collaborative activity follows.

Key points: (1) hermes-agent's engagement lead is absolute — 10x any competitor (2) 8 repos with 0 PRs = early virality, not sustained communities (3) multica's activity pattern reflects its product category
Duration: 2 minutes

---

# 08_key_takeaways

[Transition] Let me close with five observations you can take into your planning conversations.

First: AI coding agents have achieved category dominance on GitHub trending. 70% of trending repos in a single day is not a signal — it's a verdict. The developer community has decided where its attention is going.

Second: Claude Code has spawned a full ecosystem in under 24 hours. Seven-plus repos. Multiple sub-themes. That rate of community formation around a single tool is extremely unusual and suggests the ecosystem will compound rapidly.

Third: Python and TypeScript are the languages of this moment. If your tooling roadmap doesn't account for these two languages as primary targets, you're rowing against the current.

Fourth: Most of these projects are still early-stage. Stars are not community. Eight repos with zero pull requests means there's still significant space for whoever can convert this initial attention into sustained collaboration.

Fifth: Token efficiency is a harbinger. When developers start building tools to reduce costs before enterprise mandates them to, that sub-theme is about to become a product requirement.

Key points: (1) AI agent dominance — 70% (2) Claude Code ecosystem velocity (3) Python/TypeScript language priority (4) Stars ≠ community (5) Token efficiency = emerging product requirement
Duration: 2 minutes
